description: This file defines an internal object 'AiPlayer' that provides AI move selection logic for a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe game, primarily implementing the minimax algorithm to determine optimal moves.

classes.name: AiPlayer
classes.description: A singleton object that encapsulates the AI logic for selecting moves in a Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: chooseMove
methods.description: Public method to select the optimal move index (0..8) for the AI given the current board state and AI symbol.

methods.name: minimax
methods.description: Recursive helper implementing the minimax algorithm to evaluate board states and choose optimal moves.

methods.name: availableMoves
methods.description: Returns a list of available move indices on the current board.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Determines if there's a winner in the current board state.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks whether the game is a draw (full board with no winner).

methods.name: other
methods.description: Utility to get the opposite symbol ('X' or 'O').
